why: Beds explode when used in the End, and an explosion next to the perched dragon removes up to a quarter of its health per bed. The dragon only stays still while perched, so that is when the beds are used. The blast also hurts you, so a block between you and the bed is standard. Sword damage is small (the dragon takes about a quarter of damage that misses its head), so A takes many perches. C wastes beds on a moving target. D spends minutes climbing pillars. The agent on this project's seed killed the dragon with six bed explosions on one perch.
trap: A or D: the 'normal player' sword fight, which is many times slower.

techniques.description: Explode beds on the perched dragon.
